text:
maya (AE): Quick heads-up — Riverfront wants a short perf POC next week. They care about 95th pct latency under 300ms for single-turn generation at 1k RPS. Can we sketch a minimal load plan + cost estimate?

sam (SalesEng): thanks. do we have their model choice? They mentioned open Llama variant but not size. lucas, any constraint from your side?

lucas (Riverfront): goal is parity with our existing endpoint (gpu-backed, ~250ms p95). happy to try 13B quantized model first. budget is tight, but we need reliable numbers for infra ask.

priya (ML Eng): 13B quantized makes sense. For 1k RPS single-turn, we'll need batching + multiple replicas. Rough plan: start with 4x gpus (A10G-ish) running continuous batching, target effective concurrency ~64. We'll run a k6 workshop: 30s warmup, 5m steady, 2m cooldown.

chris (Infra): optional: use Dedicated burst capacity for the run to avoid noisy neighbors. I'll reserve 4 GPUs in a sandbox project. need an SSH to their network? lucas: all traffic goes over our public API; no VPC required for POC.

sam (SalesEng): ok actionable items: infra reserve + perf harness + smoke. Priya — can you provide the exact k6 script and expected metrics? Also need a loose cost calc for the AE to include in the SOW.

priya (ML Eng): putting the k6 command here:
```bash
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 7m --summary-export=summary.json post-gen.js
```
post-gen.js (very small) calls our /v1/generate endpoint with 1 prompt, records latency. Example payload snippet: 
```json
{"model":"llama-13b-q4o","input":"Summarize transaction logs"}
```
Expected metrics to report: p50/p95/p99, mean throughput (tokens/sec), GPU util, avg KV cache hit rate, and tail latency with and without batching.

maya (AE): cost calc? rough ballpark so I can sign off with customer before scheduling.

priya (ML Eng): ballpark: 4 x A10G reserved for 1 hour ~ $X (cloud vary). With Redwood batching and quantization expect ~40-60 tokens/sec per GPU for this workload => at 1k RPS average tokens per request ~ 80 => tokens/sec ~80k -> that suggests we need effective parallelism beyond 4 GPUs. hmm re-evaluating: if single-turn 80 tokens, 1k RPS == 80k tokens/s. at 50 tok/s per GPU we'd need ~1600 GPU-equivalents — unrealistic. Wait that's wrong because continuous batching increases throughput per GPU strongly. Better to express in concurrency: target concurrency 64 with KV cache and batching gives ~1k RPS across 4-8 GPUs depending on kernel/seq length. I'll provide two scenarios: conservative (8 gpus) and aggressive (4 gpus + optimized kernels).

sam (SalesEng): can you translate that into $/hour for the SOW? we can use a placeholder range.

chris (Infra): estimate: A10G on-demand ~ $2.5/hr (example). 4 GPUs => $10/hr, 8 GPUs => $20/hr. Add Redwood Dedicated baseline + network ~ $X/hr. For a 3-4 hour POC window plus prep and analysis, estimate 8-12 hours of engineer time.

lucas (Riverfront): that range is fine, please send a quick write-up. We'll approve for a 4 hour run if numbers look reasonable.

priya (ML Eng): I'll run a smoke locally and paste expected dashboard widgets: p95 target 250-350ms, GPU util 60-80%, batch size distribution, KV cache hit >= 70%. Also include fallback plan: if p95 > 400ms, fallback to bigger instance type or shard model across nodes.

sam (SalesEng): perfect. Maya i'll draft the SOW with the two options and include the perf plan + cost placeholders.

maya (AE): timeline? we can do Thursday if infra can reserve. Chris?

chris (Infra): reserving sandbox now. deploy-bot: reserving resources...

deploy-bot: resources reserved: sandbox-dedicated-01 (4 gpus) — reservation ID rsv-83a2.

chris (Infra): done. maya — i'll add slack access for lucas to the sandbox analytics dashboard.

maya (AE): thanks all. Priya — once you paste the k6 script and a quick runbook I'll send to Riverfront and lock calendar. :thumbsup:

priya (ML Eng): will post the runbook + minimal config (env vars, headers) here in next message.
